notes.title: Patch v1.1.2 — Darius Behaves & Words Make Sense
notes.notes:

notes.title: Major Update — New Hunter, New Boogey, New Bullets!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Hunters! 🔫👻[/p][p]This isn’t just a patch, this is a [b]full-on arsenal upgrade[/b]. We’ve packed this update with fresh content, shiny visuals, and some much-needed cleanup in the leaderboards. Buckle up, ‘cause here’s what’s new:[/p][h3]🌟 What’s New in This Update:[/h3][list][*][p]🧑‍🎯 [b]A brand-new Hunter joins the roster[/b]: more style, more strategies, more chaos.[/p][/*][*][p]👹 [b]A new Boogey appears[/b]: stronger, creepier, and ready to ruin your day (in the best way).[/p][/*][*][p]💥 [b]New bullets added[/b]: experiment, combo, and discover broken synergies before we inevitably nerf them. 😉[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Visual refresh[/b]: Yelena animations and some user interfaces cleaner, sharper, and prettier than ever.[/p][/*][*][p]🚫 [b]Cheaters yeeted from the leaderboard[/b]: only [i]true[/i] Hunters remain on top.[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning of a new era for [i]Boogey Hunters[/i]. With more content, more updates, and more mythical chaos on the horizon, the hunt has never been better.[/p][p]So grab your deck, load your bullets, and show the Boogeys who runs this world. 🌍💀[/p][p]Stay bold, stay spooky,
[b]— The Boogey Hunters Team[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278986/63e8d75b0a22bb6849f29181f91cbe76ad6be16f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎶 Soundtrack Drop — Hunt With Style!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey Hunters! 🎧🔫[/b][/p][p]You’ve dodged monsters, crushed Boogeys, and survived the madness…
Now it’s time to [i]vibe[/i].[/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]Official Boogey Hunters Soundtrack[/b] is now live!
Whether you’re gearing up for a fight, strolling through Pine Woods, or just pretending your commute is a boss battle — these tracks have your back.

Available now, right here on Steam — ready to stream, download, and loop endlessly while you plot your next run.[/p][p]So throw on your headphones, grab your imaginary bullet deck, and march to the beat of the hunt.
This world won’t save itself… but you might save the playlist. 😉[/p][p]Stay spooky,
[b]— The Boogey Hunters Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.6 — Leaderboard Glows, Save Woes and Harold Shows
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Hunters! 🧢💼[/p][p]Another day, another round of bug squashing! While you were out bravely battling Boogeys, we’ve been back at HQ cleaning up code, calming down bosses, and giving our leaderboard a much-needed glow-up. 🌟[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s Fixed in v1.0.6:[/h3][list][*][p]🏆 [b]Leaderboard visual update[/b] — now shinier, cleaner, and way easier on the eyes. Go chase that top spot in style![/p][/*][*][p]💾 [b]Save bugs fixed[/b] — no more spooky surprises when trying to load your progress. Your hunts are now safely tucked in.[/p][/*][*][p]🐉 [b]Harold of Lycia encounter fixed & rebalanced[/b] — Harold was acting up… again. We had a long talk with him.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for all your support, bug reports, and memes (seriously, we see them and we love them).
As always — stay bold, stay weird, and keep those Boogeys running scared.[/p][p]With appreciation and a fresh cup of bug spray,
[b]— The Boogey Hunters Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5 — Boogeypedia, Buses & Better Battles
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there, fearless Hunters! 🏹👻[/p][p]We’re back with another fresh patch — v1.0.5 — straight from the bug-zapping van. This one’s got fixes from all corners of the world (literally) and a few quality-of-life boosts that should make your hunts smoother, cleaner, and slightly less cursed. 💫[/p][h3]🛠️ Here’s What’s Cookin’ in 1.0.5:[/h3][list][*][p]🚚 [b]"Expresso Truck" encounter bug squashed & rebalanced[/b] — the truck no longer drives into the void[/p][/*][*][p]🖥️ [b]16:10 screen ratio fix[/b] — battle UI will no longer spill into the unknown. Clean edges = happy hunters.[/p][/*][*][p]📖 [b]Boogeypedia Page 2 is fixed[/b] — no more getting trapped in the ghostly archives. Flip freely, knowledge seekers![/p][/*][*][p]🌏 [b]Asian language fixes[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p]We’re loving all your feedback, bug reports, and hilarious battle screenshots. Keep 'em coming! The Boogeys won’t hunt themselves — and we’re just getting started. 😎[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us through the weird, the wild, and the wonderfully broken.
Stay sharp, stay spooky.[/p][p]With admiration and many hotfixes,
[b]— The Boogey Hunters Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Day 2 Update — Bug Fixes, Nerfs & Chaos Control
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Hunters! 👻🔫[/p][p]It’s Day 2 out in the wild, and let’s just say… things got [i]a little[/i] too spicy.
Some of you were speed-phasing through monsters like time didn’t exist, and others discovered bullet combos so powerful they probably violated interdimensional law. 🌀💥[/p][p]So we stepped in. Gently. With patch notes. 😇[/p][h3]⚙️ What’s New in the Day 2 Update:[/h3][list][*][p]🐌 [b]Phase transition speed has been nerfed[/b] — slow down there, turbo boogeys. Let the hunters [i]breathe[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]💣 [b]"Breaking The Law" + "Madness" bullet combo has been fixed[/b] — the chaos was fun while it lasted.[/p][/*][*][p]🖥️ [b]Full Screen & Resolution settings fixed[/b] — your screen is now legally obligated to behave.[/p][/*][*][p]📸 [b]Westwood ending photo fixed[/b] — it now actually shows the correct memory. Smile![/p][/*][*][p]🏆 [b]Leaderboard now works for both characters[/b] — no more favoritism.[/p][/*][*][p]🌍 [b]Localization tweaks[/b] — we fixed a few translation hiccups, so things should make a bit more sense now (we hope!).[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re keeping a close eye on all the awesome (and occasionally cursed) things you’re discovering, and more updates are on the way. Keep the feedback, screenshots, and theories coming — we love ‘em all![/p][p]Thanks for playing, breaking things, and helping us fix them.
You guys are the real Boogey busters. 💪💀[/p][p]Until tomorrow,
[b]The Boogey Hunters Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Boogey Hunters First Day Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there, Hunters! 🧢🦴[/p][p]What an incredible first day it's been! We’re beyond grateful for everyone who jumped into [i]Boogey Hunters[/i], explored the forests, chased down mythical creatures, and tested their skills against the unknown.[/p][p]Thanks to your amazing support, we've gathered tons of feedback, bug reports, and kind words—and we’re already rolling out our [b]First Day Update[/b] to make the experience even smoother.[/p][h3]🔧 Patch Notes — v1.0.1[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue of game victory.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Hexed Ammunition debuff.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked balancing for Baba Yaga phase 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Typo and localization fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p]And yes—we’ve seen your ideas. Some of them are just brilliant. We’re already planning some exciting features for future updates (did someone say more Boogeys from around the world? 👀).[/p][h3]💬 Keep Talking to Us![/h3][p]Your feedback is gold. Join the conversation, share your best moments, or tell us what made you rage-quit (it’s okay, we’ve been there too). Every message helps us make [i]Boogey Hunters[/i] even better.[/p][p]From all of us on the team — thank you for hunting with us. The journey has just begun. 🏹🌎[/p][p]Stay brave,
[b]The Boogey Hunters Team[/b][/p]
